name: KC9102A
summary: KC9102A is a SOP8 servo-control IC in KCS’s robot and model-aircraft servo component portfolio. Requires external LDO, pre-driver and MOSFETs. Package and circuit requirements are taken from the manufacturer’s selection table; final electrical operating limits require the matching datasheet.

sources.quote: KC9102A是一款专用的马达驱动芯片。电路内部集成了高精度ADC，可直接驱动外部H桥电路，适合于驱动电动玩具车的转向轮驱动。该电路VDD具备较宽的工作电压范围（从2V到5.5V）。芯片采用SOP8引脚的封装，符合RoHS 标准。
